events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road celebrated
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, originally released in 1969, is celebrated today.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing. That album. The Beatles' Abbey Road, released in 1969, still sounds incredible and that cover is one of the most famous in music history. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, born in 1946, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Eighty years ago today, a star was born. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose incredible voice and stage presence changed music forever. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde, born in 1951, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' legend has given us so many unforgettable tracks. Which one is your favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher, born in 1972, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine album remembered
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful second studio album, Imagine, originally released in 1971, is remembered today.

angles.name: Imagine the impact
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message. Remembering the enduring power of John Lennon's 'Imagine' album, first released in 1971. What does the title track mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: We remember the launch of Apple's first-generation iPod in 2001, which revolutionised portable music.

angles.name: A thousand songs in your pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, born in 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: Eighty-six years ago today, John Lennon was born. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric or Beatles track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon and Monty Python star John Cleese, born in 1939, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album by The Beatles remembered
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', originally released in 1968, is celebrated today.

angles.name: Double album delight
angles.copy: A double album that broke all the rules. The Beatles' 'White Album', released in 1968, was a sprawling masterpiece. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember Queen's legendary frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true icon. Remembering the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury, whose legacy continues to rock the world. His music will truly live forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul remembered
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A pivotal album
angles.copy: A game-changer for The Beatles. On this day in 1965, 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a new direction for the Fab Four. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Peace and Music
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a voice of peace and a musical genius. Remembering John Lennon, whose legacy continues to resonate. His message is as vital as ever.
